item.title: El Salvador deploys special forces to Haiti to help find 4 missing soldiers who came under attack
item.description: Two officials have told The Associated Press that El Salvador has deployed 100 special forces soldiers to Haiti to help recover four missing soldiers from the Central American country who recently came under attack by gangs.

item.title: Airbnb guests no longer have to wash the dishes or strip the beds at checkout
item.description: Airbnb guests may soon have fewer chores to tackle before checking out. The short-term rental platform says it is changing its rules to limit what hosts can require of guests.

item.title: US Treasury proposes a rule to crack down on high-tech investments in China, other adversaries
item.description: The U.S. Treasury Department has proposed a rule to crack down on American high-tech investments in China, Russia, North Korea and other “countries of concern.’’

item.title: Trump administration offers mixed messages on limits to Ukraine's Starshield access
